comment: 60yo male, 28 years cadmium-smelter operator (primary cadmium smelting + Cd-pigment production transitions), former-smoker quit 8 years ago, 20 pack-years cumulative. No current lung, prostate, or kidney cancer. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = risk-adjusted annual LDCT chest (cadmium-modified USPSTF criteria) + shared-decision-making PSA discussion framed with occupational-exposure context + smoking-cessation maintenance reinforcement + low-threshold renal imaging on hematuria; alternative = routine general-population USPSTF screening only. Validates v0.3 occupational batch-3 pilot — fires RF-OCC-CADMIUM-PREVENTION.
